scientific_integrity: The proof is exact and all-parameter; the 208 finite numerical and GF(2) tests are checks, not a substitute for proof. The construction and contact identities are credited to Nour; nerve theory and disphenoid coordinates are credited as prior tools.
scientific_limitations: Origin-centered inner-core balls and concentric bicentric nondegenerate three-dimensional tetrahedra only. Persistence stated for all fields; no statement for arbitrary point sets, off-center core balls or higher dimensions. Historical novelty remains provisional until independent literature audit.
title: Exact ball-union topology and inverse Čech rigidity of concentric bicentric tetrahedra
